newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Hudaco says contingent liability falls away.
newsitem.headline: Hudaco says contingent liability falls away.

text.p: Hudaco Industries Ltd said on Wednesday a 26 million rand contingent liability relating to the disallowance by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue of the use of certain assessed losses in a group company, had fallen away.

"Following detailed submissions to the Commissioner he has accepted the utilisation of the assessed losses as originally claimed by the company and accordingly the contingent liability now falls away," Hudaco said in a brief statement.
The company has been involved in protracted negotiations with the Commissioner in recent months.

In the half-year ended May 31 1996 the company lifted headline share earnings to 74 cents from 66 cents and declared a 33 cent interim dividend from 30 cents. Turnover rose to 525.9 million rand from 364 million rand.
